prompt:
Write a notice to recruit a student for Prof. Smith’s research project on campus sports activities. Specify the duties and requirements of the job.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name at the end of the notice; use “Li Ming” instead. (10 points)
title: Research Assistant Wanted
body: Prof. Smith from the School of Physical Education is looking for a student assistant for a research project on campus sports activities, which will run from March to June.

The assistant will be responsible for distributing and collecting questionnaires, interviewing students about their exercise habits and organizing the data collected. The job requires about eight hours a week, and a monthly allowance will be provided.

Applicants should be full-time students with a keen interest in sports. Good communication skills and a basic knowledge of statistical software are also required. Those interested are welcome to send a brief CV to Prof. Smith’s office, Room 305, Sports Building, before March 1.

prompt:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should
1) describe the picture briefly,
2) interpret the implied meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)

【图画】村里的河上正在举行龙舟赛，几条龙舟从石拱桥下划过，两岸挤满了观看、欢呼的村民；一对老夫妻笑着说：“真好啊，咱们村的龙舟赛越来越热闹了。”
body: As the picture shows, a dragon-boat race is being held on a river in a village. Several boats are speeding under a stone arch bridge, while crowds of villagers line both banks, cheering excitedly. Watching the lively scene, an elderly couple smile and say, “How wonderful! The dragon-boat race in our village is getting livelier every year.”

The picture reflects the revival of traditional culture in rural China. The dragon-boat race, a custom with a history of over two thousand years, is not only an exciting sport but also a symbol of teamwork and community spirit. As rural living standards have risen, villagers now have both the means and the enthusiasm to celebrate their traditions. Such festivities enrich their cultural life, strengthen the bonds among neighbors and even attract tourists, thereby boosting the local economy.

In my view, this trend deserves our applause. Traditional customs are the roots of a nation and keep our shared memories alive. Therefore, we should support folk activities, encourage young people to take part in them and integrate them into rural revitalization efforts. In this way, our traditions will not only survive but thrive, bringing new vitality to the countryside.

prompt:
An art exhibition and a robot show are to be held on Sunday, and your friend David asks you which one he should go to. Write him an email to
1) make a suggestion, and
2) give your reason(s).
Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in your email, use “Li Ming” instead. (10 points)
body: I’m glad you asked for my advice. In my opinion, the robot show would be the better choice for you.

To begin with, as a big fan of science and technology, you will find it truly fascinating. Engineers from leading companies will demonstrate their latest robots, and visitors can even interact with some of them. Moreover, you once told me that you were thinking of majoring in artificial intelligence, so the show may well give you some inspiration. Besides, art exhibitions are held quite often in our city, whereas a robot show like this is a rare opportunity.
I hope you enjoy the show and have a great Sunday!

prompt:
Write an essay based on the chart below. In your writing, you should
1) interpret the chart, and
2) give your comments.
You should write about 150 words on the ANSWER SHEET. (15 points)

【图表】2012—2021 年我国居民健康素养水平（折线图）：2012 年 8.80%，2013 年 9.48%，2014 年 9.79%，2015 年 10.25%，2016 年 11.58%，2017 年 14.18%，2018 年 17.06%，2019 年 19.17%，2020 年 23.15%，2021 年 25.40%
*健康素养（health literacy）是指个人获取和理解基本健康信息和服务，并运用这些信息和服务做出正确决策，以维护和促进自身健康的能力。健康素养水平指具备基本健康素养的人在总人群（15—69 岁城乡居民）中所占的比例。
body: The line chart illustrates the changes in the health literacy level of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. As the chart shows, the proportion of residents with basic health literacy rose year after year from 8.80% to 25.40%, nearly tripling. Notably, the growth sped up from 2016 onward, with the figure more than doubling from 11.58% to 25.40% in just five years.

Several factors may account for this trend. First, with rising living standards, people are paying increasing attention to their health. Second, the government has made great efforts to promote health education, especially since the Healthy China 2030 plan was issued in 2016. Third, the Internet has made it much easier for people to obtain reliable health information.

In my opinion, this improvement is encouraging, yet there is still much room for progress, since about three quarters of residents lack basic health literacy. Therefore, health knowledge should be spread more widely, especially in rural areas, so that everyone can make wise decisions about their health.
